# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1313
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1313
- **Title**: feat(1079): SDK slice 3 — builder-owned task/subagent/fabric complex
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1079-sdk-host-slice3` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +713
- **Deletions**: -252
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T09:54:56Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T09:54:56Z

## PR Description

Part of #1079

## Delivered (slice 3 — builder-owned jobs)

**The task/subagent/fabric complex moves into the capability-gated assembled set (PR #1230's first "Remaining" item); the CLI no longer passes `task`/monitoring as post-plan host tools nor hand-assembles the manager.**

- **`SubagentServices`** (`lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart`, new) — the typed bundle of genuinely shell-side glue: wake launcher, registry sink/source, heartbeat delivery + live thresholds, roles resolver, children's compaction choice, misuse-breaker switch, child-session factory, session-IO retry. Absent bundle = the capability run-narrows `off(reason: … subagentServices …)` like any missing platform service — the complex never half-wires.
- **`_wireFabric` / `_wireTaskSurface`** — the builder assembles the messaging fabric (file layer over `sessionRoot`; hub primary only when the hub transport survived run-narrowing; E1-loud when the hub wires without a `mainMailbox` resolver), then the `SubagentManager` → A2A gateway (a2a transport) → heartbeat (started, kill-switch aware) → `TaskToolConfig` (children draw the child-safe core list; live stream/model accessors) → monitoring tools → `task`, gated by `HostCapability.messagingFabric`/`HostCapability.subagents`.
- **Registry order preserved byte-identically**: `buildAgentStack` now emits core tools → gated task surface (monitoring, then `task` LAST) → residual `additionalTools` — exactly the pre-conversion registration order. The gated surface stays OUT of `WiredAgentCore.tools` (children must never draw it; the executor strips only `task` itself).
- **Catalog corrections** — `subagents` now requires `{sessionRoot, subagentServices}`; `messagingFabric`'s file transport declares `sessionRoot` per-transport (a hub-only host without a session root no longer silently promises the file layer).
- **`WiredAgentCore` exposes the handles** (`fabric`, `fileFabric`, `messagesRoot`, `subagentManager`, `a2aManager`, `subagentHeartbeat`, `taskConfig`) — the CLI (`AgentCli`) keeps `/agents`, wake, mailbox and job-manager behavior unchanged, passing only callbacks (registry persistence closures, `_launchMailboxWake`, `_deliverHeartbeatDigest`, child-session minting over `_repo`). Net: the shell lost ~140 lines of hand-rolled assembly.
- **AGENTS.md** — the host-shell wiring rule now names the builder-owned task complex (conventions invariant).

## Remaining (later slices, per the issue)

- Checkpoint/roles/queue/approval/redaction post-construction attachments into the builder (slice 4).
- Model-facing emission through the plan (prompt sections/help driven by `surfacedTokens`).
- Remaining host shells (macOS/iOS/Android/web/extension/Outlook) consume `wireAgentCore`; config-section parity (#1078) generalizes onto the builder per OQ1.

## Local verification (honest disclosure)

The main checkout's system dart is unusable here (flutter shim dies on seatbelt-blocked engine-stamp writes; the bare VM is SIGKILLed with exit 137 by the machine guard — the known lane pitfall). Gates ran in the worktree via a sibling lane's temp Dart SDK 3.13.4 + the fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`:

- `dart test test/hosts/ test/parity/` — **80/80 green** (matrix completeness, E1/E2, AC7 hiding, parity guards).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart` — **87/87 green** (the CLI constructor end-to-end over the moved wiring).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_agents_panel_test.dart test/task/subagent_lifecycle_test.dart` — **36/36 green** (registry persistence/rehydration through the builder-assembled manager; child resume/wake).
- `dart analyze lib/src/hosts lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart test/hosts` — clean. `dart format` applied (3.13.4; it reflowed two pre-existing spots in the hosts test/catalog that the previous slice's formatter version had left non-canonical).

New tests fail-first: the slice-3 group was written before the implementation (absent-bundle narrowing, child-safety of the core list, canonical order, fabric composition, handle exposure, off-profile hiding) and went green with the builder changes.

- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T09:54:56Z

## PR Description

Part of #1079

## Delivered (slice 3 — builder-owned jobs)

**The task/subagent/fabric complex moves into the capability-gated assembled set (PR #1230's first "Remaining" item); the CLI no longer passes `task`/monitoring as post-plan host tools nor hand-assembles the manager.**

- **`SubagentServices`** (`lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart`, new) — the typed bundle of genuinely shell-side glue: wake launcher, registry sink/source, heartbeat delivery + live thresholds, roles resolver, children's compaction choice, misuse-breaker switch, child-session factory, session-IO retry. Absent bundle = the capability run-narrows `off(reason: … subagentServices …)` like any missing platform service — the complex never half-wires.
- **`_wireFabric` / `_wireTaskSurface`** — the builder assembles the messaging fabric (file layer over `sessionRoot`; hub primary only when the hub transport survived run-narrowing; E1-loud when the hub wires without a `mainMailbox` resolver), then the `SubagentManager` → A2A gateway (a2a transport) → heartbeat (started, kill-switch aware) → `TaskToolConfig` (children draw the child-safe core list; live stream/model accessors) → monitoring tools → `task`, gated by `HostCapability.messagingFabric`/`HostCapability.subagents`.
- **Registry order preserved byte-identically**: `buildAgentStack` now emits core tools → gated task surface (monitoring, then `task` LAST) → residual `additionalTools` — exactly the pre-conversion registration order. The gated surface stays OUT of `WiredAgentCore.tools` (children must never draw it; the executor strips only `task` itself).
- **Catalog corrections** — `subagents` now requires `{sessionRoot, subagentServices}`; `messagingFabric`'s file transport declares `sessionRoot` per-transport (a hub-only host without a session root no longer silently promises the file layer).
- **`WiredAgentCore` exposes the handles** (`fabric`, `fileFabric`, `messagesRoot`, `subagentManager`, `a2aManager`, `subagentHeartbeat`, `taskConfig`) — the CLI (`AgentCli`) keeps `/agents`, wake, mailbox and job-manager behavior unchanged, passing only callbacks (registry persistence closures, `_launchMailboxWake`, `_deliverHeartbeatDigest`, child-session minting over `_repo`). Net: the shell lost ~140 lines of hand-rolled assembly.
- **AGENTS.md** — the host-shell wiring rule now names the builder-owned task complex (conventions invariant).

## Remaining (later slices, per the issue)

- Checkpoint/roles/queue/approval/redaction post-construction attachments into the builder (slice 4).
- Model-facing emission through the plan (prompt sections/help driven by `surfacedTokens`).
- Remaining host shells (macOS/iOS/Android/web/extension/Outlook) consume `wireAgentCore`; config-section parity (#1078) generalizes onto the builder per OQ1.

## Local verification (honest disclosure)

The main checkout's system dart is unusable here (flutter shim dies on seatbelt-blocked engine-stamp writes; the bare VM is SIGKILLed with exit 137 by the machine guard — the known lane pitfall). Gates ran in the worktree via a sibling lane's temp Dart SDK 3.13.4 + the fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`:

- `dart test test/hosts/ test/parity/` — **80/80 green** (matrix completeness, E1/E2, AC7 hiding, parity guards).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart` — **87/87 green** (the CLI constructor end-to-end over the moved wiring).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_agents_panel_test.dart test/task/subagent_lifecycle_test.dart` — **36/36 green** (registry persistence/rehydration through the builder-assembled manager; child resume/wake).
- `dart analyze lib/src/hosts lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart test/hosts` — clean. `dart format` applied (3.13.4; it reflowed two pre-existing spots in the hosts test/catalog that the previous slice's formatter version had left non-canonical).

New tests fail-first: the slice-3 group was written before the implementation (absent-bundle narrowing, child-safety of the core list, canonical order, fabric composition, handle exposure, off-profile hiding) and went green with the builder changes.

- **Title**: feat(1079): SDK slice 3 — builder-owned task/subagent/fabric complex
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1079-sdk-host-slice3` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +713
- **Deletions**: -252
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T09:54:56Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T09:54:56Z

## PR Description

Part of #1079

## Delivered (slice 3 — builder-owned jobs)

**The task/subagent/fabric complex moves into the capability-gated assembled set (PR #1230's first "Remaining" item); the CLI no longer passes `task`/monitoring as post-plan host tools nor hand-assembles the manager.**

- **`SubagentServices`** (`lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart`, new) — the typed bundle of genuinely shell-side glue: wake launcher, registry sink/source, heartbeat delivery + live thresholds, roles resolver, children's compaction choice, misuse-breaker switch, child-session factory, session-IO retry. Absent bundle = the capability run-narrows `off(reason: … subagentServices …)` like any missing platform service — the complex never half-wires.
- **`_wireFabric` / `_wireTaskSurface`** — the builder assembles the messaging fabric (file layer over `sessionRoot`; hub primary only when the hub transport survived run-narrowing; E1-loud when the hub wires without a `mainMailbox` resolver), then the `SubagentManager` → A2A gateway (a2a transport) → heartbeat (started, kill-switch aware) → `TaskToolConfig` (children draw the child-safe core list; live stream/model accessors) → monitoring tools → `task`, gated by `HostCapability.messagingFabric`/`HostCapability.subagents`.
- **Registry order preserved byte-identically**: `buildAgentStack` now emits core tools → gated task surface (monitoring, then `task` LAST) → residual `additionalTools` — exactly the pre-conversion registration order. The gated surface stays OUT of `WiredAgentCore.tools` (children must never draw it; the executor strips only `task` itself).
- **Catalog corrections** — `subagents` now requires `{sessionRoot, subagentServices}`; `messagingFabric`'s file transport declares `sessionRoot` per-transport (a hub-only host without a session root no longer silently promises the file layer).
- **`WiredAgentCore` exposes the handles** (`fabric`, `fileFabric`, `messagesRoot`, `subagentManager`, `a2aManager`, `subagentHeartbeat`, `taskConfig`) — the CLI (`AgentCli`) keeps `/agents`, wake, mailbox and job-manager behavior unchanged, passing only callbacks (registry persistence closures, `_launchMailboxWake`, `_deliverHeartbeatDigest`, child-session minting over `_repo`). Net: the shell lost ~140 lines of hand-rolled assembly.
- **AGENTS.md** — the host-shell wiring rule now names the builder-owned task complex (conventions invariant).

## Remaining (later slices, per the issue)

- Checkpoint/roles/queue/approval/redaction post-construction attachments into the builder (slice 4).
- Model-facing emission through the plan (prompt sections/help driven by `surfacedTokens`).
- Remaining host shells (macOS/iOS/Android/web/extension/Outlook) consume `wireAgentCore`; config-section parity (#1078) generalizes onto the builder per OQ1.

## Local verification (honest disclosure)

The main checkout's system dart is unusable here (flutter shim dies on seatbelt-blocked engine-stamp writes; the bare VM is SIGKILLed with exit 137 by the machine guard — the known lane pitfall). Gates ran in the worktree via a sibling lane's temp Dart SDK 3.13.4 + the fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`:

- `dart test test/hosts/ test/parity/` — **80/80 green** (matrix completeness, E1/E2, AC7 hiding, parity guards).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart` — **87/87 green** (the CLI constructor end-to-end over the moved wiring).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_agents_panel_test.dart test/task/subagent_lifecycle_test.dart` — **36/36 green** (registry persistence/rehydration through the builder-assembled manager; child resume/wake).
- `dart analyze lib/src/hosts lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart test/hosts` — clean. `dart format` applied (3.13.4; it reflowed two pre-existing spots in the hosts test/catalog that the previous slice's formatter version had left non-canonical).

New tests fail-first: the slice-3 group was written before the implementation (absent-bundle narrowing, child-safety of the core list, canonical order, fabric composition, handle exposure, off-profile hiding) and went green with the builder changes.

## Delivered (slice 3 — builder-owned jobs)

**The task/subagent/fabric complex moves into the capability-gated assembled set (PR #1230's first "Remaining" item); the CLI no longer passes `task`/monitoring as post-plan host tools nor hand-assembles the manager.**

- **`SubagentServices`** (`lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart`, new) — the typed bundle of genuinely shell-side glue: wake launcher, registry sink/source, heartbeat delivery + live thresholds, roles resolver, children's compaction choice, misuse-breaker switch, child-session factory, session-IO retry. Absent bundle = the capability run-narrows `off(reason: … subagentServices …)` like any missing platform service — the complex never half-wires.
- **`_wireFabric` / `_wireTaskSurface`** — the builder assembles the messaging fabric (file layer over `sessionRoot`; hub primary only when the hub transport survived run-narrowing; E1-loud when the hub wires without a `mainMailbox` resolver), then the `SubagentManager` → A2A gateway (a2a transport) → heartbeat (started, kill-switch aware) → `TaskToolConfig` (children draw the child-safe core list; live stream/model accessors) → monitoring tools → `task`, gated by `HostCapability.messagingFabric`/`HostCapability.subagents`.

The gated surface stays OUT of `WiredAgentCore.tools` (children must never draw it; the executor strips only `task` itself).

# pr-1313: feat(1079): SDK slice 3 — builder-owned task/subagent/fabric complex

## Description

Part of #1079

## Delivered (slice 3 — builder-owned jobs)

**The task/subagent/fabric complex moves into the capability-gated assembled set (PR #1230's first "Remaining" item); the CLI no longer passes `task`/monitoring as post-plan host tools nor hand-assembles the manager.**

- **`SubagentServices`** (`lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart`, new) — the typed bundle of genuinely shell-side glue: wake launcher, registry sink/source, heartbeat delivery + live thresholds, roles resolver, children's compaction choice, misuse-breaker switch, child-session factory, session-IO retry. Absent bundle = the capability run-narrows `off(reason: … subagentServices …)` like any missing platform service — the complex never half-wires.
- **`_wireFabric` / `_wireTaskSurface`** — the builder assembles the messaging fabric (file layer over `sessionRoot`; hub primary only when the hub transport survived run-narrowing; E1-loud when the hub wires without a `mainMailbox` resolver), then the `SubagentManager` → A2A gateway (a2a transport) → heartbeat (started, kill-switch aware) → `TaskToolConfig` (children draw the child-safe core list; live stream/model accessors) → monitoring tools → `task`, gated by `HostCapability.messagingFabric`/`HostCapability.subagents`.
- **Registry order preserved byte-identically**: `buildAgentStack` now emits core tools → gated task surface (monitoring, then `task` LAST) → residual `additionalTools` — exactly the pre-conversion registration order. The gated surface stays OUT of `WiredAgentCore.tools` (children must never draw it; the executor strips only `task` itself).
- **Catalog corrections** — `subagents` now requires `{sessionRoot, subagentServices}`; `messagingFabric`'s file transport declares `sessionRoot` per-transport (a hub-only host without a session root no longer silently promises the file layer).
- **`WiredAgentCore` exposes the handles** (`fabric`, `fileFabric`, `messagesRoot`, `subagentManager`, `a2aManager`, `subagentHeartbeat`, `taskConfig`) — the CLI (`AgentCli`) keeps `/agents`, wake, mailbox and job-manager behavior unchanged, passing only callbacks (registry persistence closures, `_launchMailboxWake`, `_deliverHeartbeatDigest`, child-session minting over `_repo`). Net: the shell lost ~140 lines of hand-rolled assembly.
- **AGENTS.md** — the host-shell wiring rule now names the builder-owned task complex (conventions invariant).

## Remaining (later slices, per the issue)

- Checkpoint/roles/queue/approval/redaction post-construction attachments into the builder (slice 4).
- Model-facing emission through the plan (prompt sections/help driven by `surfacedTokens`).
- Remaining host shells (macOS/iOS/Android/web/extension/Outlook) consume `wireAgentCore`; config-section parity (#1078) generalizes onto the builder per OQ1.

## Local verification (honest disclosure)

The main checkout's system dart is unusable here (flutter shim dies on seatbelt-blocked engine-stamp writes; the bare VM is SIGKILLed with exit 137 by the machine guard — the known lane pitfall). - `dart test test/hosts/ test/parity/` — **80/80 green** (matrix completeness, E1/E2, AC7 hiding, parity guards).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart` — **87/87 green** (the CLI constructor end-to-end over the moved wiring).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_agents_panel_test.dart test/task/subagent_lifecycle_test.dart` — **36/36 green** (registry persistence/rehydration through the builder-assembled manager; child resume/wake).
- `dart analyze lib/src/hosts lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart test/hosts` — clean. `dart format` applied (3.13.4; it reflowed two pre-existing spots in the hosts test/catalog that the previous slice's formatter version had left non-canonical).

New tests fail-first: the slice-3 group was written before the implementation (absent-bundle narrowing, child-safety of the core list, canonical order, fabric composition, handle exposure, off-profile hiding) and went green with the builder changes.

# pr-1313: feat(1079): SDK slice 3 — builder-owned task/subagent/fabric complex

## Description

Part of #1079

## Delivered (slice 3 — builder-owned jobs)

**The task/subagent/fabric complex moves into the capability-gated assembled set (PR #1230's first "Remaining" item); the CLI no longer passes `task`/monitoring as post-plan host tools nor hand-assembles the manager.**

- **`SubagentServices`** (`lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart`, new) — the typed bundle of genuinely shell-side glue: wake launcher, registry sink/source, heartbeat delivery + live thresholds, roles resolver, children's compaction choice, misuse-breaker switch, child-session factory, session-IO retry. Absent bundle = the capability run-narrows `off(reason: … subagentServices …)` like any missing platform service — the complex never half-wires.
- **`_wireFabric` / `_wireTaskSurface`** — the builder assembles the messaging fabric (file layer over `sessionRoot`; hub primary only when the hub transport survived run-narrowing; E1-loud when the hub wires without a `mainMailbox` resolver), then the `SubagentManager` → A2A gateway (a2a transport) → heartbeat (started, kill-switch aware) → `TaskToolConfig` (children draw the child-safe core list; live stream/model accessors) → monitoring tools → `task`, gated by `HostCapability.messagingFabric`/`HostCapability.subagents`.
- **Registry order preserved byte-identically**: `buildAgentStack` now emits core tools → gated task surface (monitoring, then `task` LAST) → residual `additionalTools` — exactly the pre-conversion registration order. The gated surface stays OUT of `WiredAgentCore.tools` (children must never draw it; the executor strips only `task` itself).
- **Catalog corrections** — `subagents` now requires `{sessionRoot, subagentServices}`; `messagingFabric`'s file transport declares `sessionRoot` per-transport (a hub-only host without a session root no longer silently promises the file layer).
- **`WiredAgentCore` exposes the handles** (`fabric`, `fileFabric`, `messagesRoot`, `subagentManager`, `a2aManager`, `subagentHeartbeat`, `taskConfig`) — the CLI (`AgentCli`) keeps `/agents`, wake, mailbox and job-manager behavior unchanged, passing only callbacks (registry persistence closures, `_launchMailboxWake`, `_deliverHeartbeatDigest`, child-session minting over `_repo`). Net: the shell lost ~140 lines of hand-rolled assembly.
- **AGENTS.md** — the host-shell wiring rule now names the builder-owned task complex (conventions invariant).

## Remaining (later slices, per the issue)

- Checkpoint/roles/queue/approval/redaction post-construction attachments into the builder (slice 4).
- Model-facing emission through the plan (prompt sections/help driven by `surfacedTokens`).
- Remaining host shells (macOS/iOS/Android/web/extension/Outlook) consume `wireAgentCore`; config-section parity (#1078) generalizes onto the builder per OQ1.

## Local verification (honest disclosure)

The main checkout's system dart is unusable here (flutter shim dies on seatbelt-blocked engine-stamp writes; the bare VM is SIGKILLed with exit 137 by the machine guard — the known lane pitfall). Gates ran in the worktree via a sibling lane's temp Dart SDK 3.13.4 + the fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`:

- `dart test test/hosts/ test/parity/` — **80/80 green** (matrix completeness, E1/E2, AC7 hiding, parity guards).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart` — **87/87 green** (the CLI constructor end-to-end over the moved wiring).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_agents_panel_test.dart test/task/subagent_lifecycle_test.dart` — **36/36 green** (registry persistence/rehydration through the builder-assembled manager; child resume/wake).
- `dart analyze lib/src/hosts lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart test/hosts` — clean. `dart format` applied (3.13.4; it reflowed two pre-existing spots in the hosts test/catalog that the previous slice's formatter version had left non-canonical).

New tests fail-first: the slice-3 group was written before the implementation (absent-bundle narrowing, child-safety of the core list, canonical order, fabric composition, handle exposure, off-profile hiding) and went green with the builder changes.

## PR Description

Part of #1079

## Delivered (slice 3 — builder-owned jobs)

**The task/subagent/fabric complex moves into the capability-gated assembled set (PR #1230's first "Remaining" item); the CLI no longer passes `task`/monitoring as post-plan host tools nor hand-assembles the manager.**

- **`SubagentServices`** (`lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart`, new) — the typed bundle of genuinely shell-side glue: wake launcher, registry sink/source, heartbeat delivery + live thresholds, roles resolver, children's compaction choice, misuse-breaker switch, child-session factory, session-IO retry. Absent bundle = the capability run-narrows `off(reason: … subagentServices …)` like any missing platform service — the complex never half-wires.
- **`_wireFabric` / `_wireTaskSurface`** — the builder assembles the messaging fabric (file layer over `sessionRoot`; hub primary only when the hub transport survived run-narrowing; E1-loud when the hub wires without a `mainMailbox` resolver), then the `SubagentManager` → A2A gateway (a2a transport) → heartbeat (started, kill-switch aware) → `TaskToolConfig` (children draw the child-safe core list; live stream/model accessors) → monitoring tools → `task`, gated by `HostCapability.messagingFabric`/`HostCapability.subagents`.
- **Registry order preserved byte-identically**: `buildAgentStack` now emits core tools → gated task surface (monitoring, then `task` LAST) → residual `additionalTools` — exactly the pre-conversion registration order. The gated surface stays OUT of `WiredAgentCore.tools` (children must never draw it; the executor strips only `task` itself).
- **Catalog corrections** — `subagents` now requires `{sessionRoot, subagentServices}`; `messagingFabric`'s file transport declares `sessionRoot` per-transport (a hub-only host without a session root no longer silently promises the file layer).
- **`WiredAgentCore` exposes the handles** (`fabric`, `fileFabric`, `messagesRoot`, `subagentManager`, `a2aManager`, `subagentHeartbeat`, `taskConfig`) — the CLI (`AgentCli`) keeps `/agents`, wake, mailbox and job-manager behavior unchanged, passing only callbacks (registry persistence closures, `_launchMailboxWake`, `_deliverHeartbeatDigest`, child-session minting over `_repo`). Net: the shell lost ~140 lines of hand-rolled assembly.
- **AGENTS.md** — the host-shell wiring rule now names the builder-owned task complex (conventions invariant).

## Remaining (later slices, per the issue)

- Checkpoint/roles/queue/approval/redaction post-construction attachments into the builder (slice 4).
- Model-facing emission through the plan (prompt sections/help driven by `surfacedTokens`).
- Remaining host shells (macOS/iOS/Android/web/extension/Outlook) consume `wireAgentCore`; config-section parity (#1078) generalizes onto the builder per OQ1.

## Local verification (honest disclosure)

The main checkout's system dart is unusable here (flutter shim dies on seatbelt-blocked engine-stamp writes; the bare VM is SIGKILLed with exit 137 by the machine guard — the known lane pitfall). Gates ran in the worktree via a sibling lane's temp Dart SDK 3.13.4 + the fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`:

- `dart test test/hosts/ test/parity/` — **80/80 green** (matrix completeness, E1/E2, AC7 hiding, parity guards).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart` — **87/87 green** (the CLI constructor end-to-end over the moved wiring).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_agents_panel_test.dart test/task/subagent_lifecycle_test.dart` — **36/36 green** (registry persistence/rehydration through the builder-assembled manager; child resume/wake).
- `dart analyze lib/src/hosts lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart test/hosts` — clean. `dart format` applied (3.13.4; it reflowed two pre-existing spots in the hosts test/catalog that the previous slice's formatter version had left non-canonical).

New tests fail-first: the slice-3 group was written before the implementation (absent-bundle narrowing, child-safety of the core list, canonical order, fabric composition, handle exposure, off-profile hiding) and went green with the builder changes.

## PR Description

Part of #1079

## Delivered (slice 3 — builder-owned jobs)

**The task/subagent/fabric complex moves into the capability-gated assembled set (PR #1230's first "Remaining" item); the CLI no longer passes `task`/monitoring as post-plan host tools nor hand-assembles the manager.**

- **`SubagentServices`** (`lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart`, new) — the typed bundle of genuinely shell-side glue: wake launcher, registry sink/source, heartbeat delivery + live thresholds, roles resolver, children's compaction choice, misuse-breaker switch, child-session factory, session-IO retry. Absent bundle = the capability run-narrows `off(reason: … subagentServices …)` like any missing platform service — the complex never half-wires.
- **`_wireFabric` / `_wireTaskSurface`** — the builder assembles the messaging fabric (file layer over `sessionRoot`; hub primary only when the hub transport survived run-narrowing; E1-loud when the hub wires without a `mainMailbox` resolver), then the `SubagentManager` → A2A gateway (a2a transport) → heartbeat (started, kill-switch aware) → `TaskToolConfig` (children draw the child-safe core list; live stream/model accessors) → monitoring tools → `task`, gated by `HostCapability.messagingFabric`/`HostCapability.subagents`.
- **Registry order preserved byte-identically**: `buildAgentStack` now emits core tools → gated task surface (monitoring, then `task` LAST) → residual `additionalTools` — exactly the pre-conversion registration order. The gated surface stays OUT of `WiredAgentCore.tools` (children must never draw it; the executor strips only `task` itself).
- **Catalog corrections** — `subagents` now requires `{sessionRoot, subagentServices}`; `messagingFabric`'s file transport declares `sessionRoot` per-transport (a hub-only host without a session root no longer silently promises the file layer).
- **`WiredAgentCore` exposes the handles** (`fabric`, `fileFabric`, `messagesRoot`, `subagentManager`, `a2aManager`, `subagentHeartbeat`, `taskConfig`) — the CLI (`AgentCli`) keeps `/agents`, wake, mailbox and job-manager behavior unchanged, passing only callbacks (registry persistence closures, `_launchMailboxWake`, `_deliverHeartbeatDigest`, child-session minting over `_repo`). Net: the shell lost ~140 lines of hand-rolled assembly.
- **AGENTS.md** — the host-shell wiring rule now names the builder-owned task complex (conventions invariant).

## Remaining (later slices, per the issue)

- Checkpoint/roles/queue/approval/redaction post-construction attachments into the builder (slice 4).
- Model-facing emission through the plan (prompt sections/help driven by `surfacedTokens`).
- Remaining host shells (macOS/iOS/Android/web/extension/Outlook) consume `wireAgentCore`; config-section parity (#1078) generalizes onto the builder per OQ1.

## Local verification (honest disclosure)

The main checkout's system dart is unusable here (flutter shim dies on seatbelt-blocked engine-stamp writes; the bare VM is SIGKILLed with exit 137 by the machine guard — the known lane pitfall). Gates ran in the worktree via a sibling lane's temp Dart SDK 3.13.4 + the fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`:

- `dart test test/hosts/ test/parity/` — **80/80 green** (matrix completeness, E1/E2, AC7 hiding, parity guards).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart` — **87/87 green** (the CLI constructor end-to-end over the moved wiring).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_agents_panel_test.dart test/task/subagent_lifecycle_test.dart` — **36/36 green** (registry persistence/rehydration through the builder-assembled manager; child resume/wake).
- `dart analyze lib/src/hosts lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart test/hosts` — clean. `dart format` applied (3.13.4; it reflowed two pre-existing spots in the hosts test/catalog that the previous slice's formatter version had left non-canonical).

New tests fail-first: the slice-3 group was written before the implementation (absent-bundle narrowing, child-safety of the core list, canonical order, fabric composition, handle exposure, off-profile hiding) and went green with the builder changes.

The question is: is there a path where the hub primary calls `mainMailbox` BEFORE `_subagentManager` is assigned? Since `_subagentManager = wired.subagentManager!` is assigned right after `wireAgentCore` returns, and the closure is only invoked at mail time, it should be fine. But what if the CLI profile has `subagents` off (e.g. a config where subagents capability is off) while hubFabric is provided? # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1313
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1313
- **Title**: feat(1079): SDK slice 3 — builder-owned task/subagent/fabric complex
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1079-sdk-host-slice3` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +713
- **Deletions**: -252
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T09:54:56Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T09:54:56Z

## PR Description

Part of #1079

## Delivered (slice 3 — builder-owned jobs)

**The task/subagent/fabric complex moves into the capability-gated assembled set (PR #1230's first "Remaining" item); the CLI no longer passes `task`/monitoring as post-plan host tools nor hand-assembles the manager.**

- **`SubagentServices`** (`lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart`, new) — the typed bundle of genuinely shell-side glue: wake launcher, registry sink/source, heartbeat delivery + live thresholds, roles resolver, children's compaction choice, misuse-breaker switch, child-session factory, session-IO retry. Absent bundle = the capability run-narrows `off(reason: … subagentServices …)` like any missing platform service — the complex never half-wires.
- **`_wireFabric` / `_wireTaskSurface`** — the builder assembles the messaging fabric (file layer over `sessionRoot`; hub primary only when the hub transport survived run-narrowing; E1-loud when the hub wires without a `mainMailbox` resolver), then the `SubagentManager` → A2A gateway (a2a transport) → heartbeat (started, kill-switch aware) → `TaskToolConfig` (children draw the child-safe core list; live stream/model accessors) → monitoring tools → `task`, gated by `HostCapability.messagingFabric`/`HostCapability.subagents`.
- **Registry order preserved byte-identically**: `buildAgentStack` now emits core tools → gated task surface (monitoring, then `task` LAST) → residual `additionalTools` — exactly the pre-conversion registration order. The gated surface stays OUT of `WiredAgentCore.tools` (children must never draw it; the executor strips only `task` itself).
- **Catalog corrections** — `subagents` now requires `{sessionRoot, subagentServices}`; `messagingFabric`'s file transport declares `sessionRoot` per-transport (a hub-only host without a session root no longer silently promises the file layer).
- **`WiredAgentCore` exposes the handles** (`fabric`, `fileFabric`, `messagesRoot`, `subagentManager`, `a2aManager`, `subagentHeartbeat`, `taskConfig`) — the CLI (`AgentCli`) keeps `/agents`, wake, mailbox and job-manager behavior unchanged, passing only callbacks (registry persistence closures, `_launchMailboxWake`, `_deliverHeartbeatDigest`, child-session minting over `_repo`). Net: the shell lost ~140 lines of hand-rolled assembly.
- **AGENTS.md** — the host-shell wiring rule now names the builder-owned task complex (conventions invariant).

## Remaining (later slices, per the issue)

- Checkpoint/roles/queue/approval/redaction post-construction attachments into the builder (slice 4).
- Model-facing emission through the plan (prompt sections/help driven by `surfacedTokens`).
- Remaining host shells (macOS/iOS/Android/web/extension/Outlook) consume `wireAgentCore`; config-section parity (#1078) generalizes onto the builder per OQ1.

## Local verification (honest disclosure)

The main checkout's system dart is unusable here (flutter shim dies on seatbelt-blocked engine-stamp writes; the bare VM is SIGKILLed with exit 137 by the machine guard — the known lane pitfall). Gates ran in the worktree via a sibling lane's temp Dart SDK 3.13.4 + the fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`:

- `dart test test/hosts/ test/parity/` — **80/80 green** (matrix completeness, E1/E2, AC7 hiding, parity guards).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart` — **87/87 green** (the CLI constructor end-to-end over the moved wiring).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_agents_panel_test.dart test/task/subagent_lifecycle_test.dart` — **36/36 green** (registry persistence/rehydration through the builder-assembled manager; child resume/wake).
- `dart analyze lib/src/hosts lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart test/hosts` — clean. `dart format` applied (3.13.4; it reflowed two pre-existing spots in the hosts test/catalog that the previous slice's formatter version had left non-canonical).

New tests fail-first: the slice-3 group was written before the implementation (absent-bundle narrowing, child-safety of the core list, canonical order, fabric composition, handle exposure, off-profile hiding) and went green with the builder changes.

- **Branch**: `fix/1079-sdk-host-slice3` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +713
- **Deletions**: -252
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T09:54:56Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T09:54:56Z

## PR Description

Part of #1079

## Delivered (slice 3 — builder-owned jobs)

**The task/subagent/fabric complex moves into the capability-gated assembled set (PR #1230's first "Remaining" item); the CLI no longer passes `task`/monitoring as post-plan host tools nor hand-assembles the manager.**

- **`SubagentServices`** (`lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart`, new) — the typed bundle of genuinely shell-side glue: wake launcher, registry sink/source, heartbeat delivery + live thresholds, roles resolver, children's compaction choice, misuse-breaker switch, child-session factory, session-IO retry. Absent bundle = the capability run-narrows `off(reason: … subagentServices …)` like any missing platform service — the complex never half-wires.
- **`_wireFabric` / `_wireTaskSurface`** — the builder assembles the messaging fabric (file layer over `sessionRoot`; hub primary only when the hub transport survived run-narrowing; E1-loud when the hub wires without a `mainMailbox` resolver), then the `SubagentManager` → A2A gateway (a2a transport) → heartbeat (started, kill-switch aware) → `TaskToolConfig` (children draw the child-safe core list; live stream/model accessors) → monitoring tools → `task`, gated by `HostCapability.messagingFabric`/`HostCapability.subagents`.
- **Registry order preserved byte-identically**: `buildAgentStack` now emits core tools → gated task surface (monitoring, then `task` LAST) → residual `additionalTools` — exactly the pre-conversion registration order. The gated surface stays OUT of `WiredAgentCore.tools` (children must never draw it; the executor strips only `task` itself).
- **Catalog corrections** — `subagents` now requires `{sessionRoot, subagentServices}`; `messagingFabric`'s file transport declares `sessionRoot` per-transport (a hub-only host without a session root no longer silently promises the file layer).
- **`WiredAgentCore` exposes the handles** (`fabric`, `fileFabric`, `messagesRoot`, `subagentManager`, `a2aManager`, `subagentHeartbeat`, `taskConfig`) — the CLI (`AgentCli`) keeps `/agents`, wake, mailbox and job-manager behavior unchanged, passing only callbacks (registry persistence closures, `_launchMailboxWake`, `_deliverHeartbeatDigest`, child-session minting over `_repo`). Net: the shell lost ~140 lines of hand-rolled assembly.
- **AGENTS.md** — the host-shell wiring rule now names the builder-owned task complex (conventions invariant).

## Remaining (later slices, per the issue)

- Checkpoint/roles/queue/approval/redaction post-construction attachments into the builder (slice 4).
- Model-facing emission through the plan (prompt sections/help driven by `surfacedTokens`).
- Remaining host shells (macOS/iOS/Android/web/extension/Outlook) consume `wireAgentCore`; config-section parity (#1078) generalizes onto the builder per OQ1.

## Local verification (honest disclosure)

The main checkout's system dart is unusable here (flutter shim dies on seatbelt-blocked engine-stamp writes; the bare VM is SIGKILLed with exit 137 by the machine guard — the known lane pitfall). Gates ran in the worktree via a sibling lane's temp Dart SDK 3.13.4 + the fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`:

- `dart test test/hosts/ test/parity/` — **80/80 green** (matrix completeness, E1/E2, AC7 hiding, parity guards).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart` — **87/87 green** (the CLI constructor end-to-end over the moved wiring).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_agents_panel_test.dart test/task/subagent_lifecycle_test.dart` — **36/36 green** (registry persistence/rehydration through the builder-assembled manager; child resume/wake).
- `dart analyze lib/src/hosts lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart test/hosts` — clean. `dart format` applied (3.13.4; it reflowed two pre-existing spots in the hosts test/catalog that the previous slice's formatter version had left non-canonical).

New tests fail-first: the slice-3 group was written before the implementation (absent-bundle narrowing, child-safety of the core list, canonical order, fabric composition, handle exposure, off-profile hiding) and went green with the builder changes.

- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1079-sdk-host-slice3` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +713
- **Deletions**: -252
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T09:54:56Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T09:54:56Z

## PR Description

Part of #1079

## Delivered (slice 3 — builder-owned jobs)

**The task/subagent/fabric complex moves into the capability-gated assembled set (PR #1230's first "Remaining" item); the CLI no longer passes `task`/monitoring as post-plan host tools nor hand-assembles the manager.**

- **`SubagentServices`** (`lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart`, new) — the typed bundle of genuinely shell-side glue: wake launcher, registry sink/source, heartbeat delivery + live thresholds, roles resolver, children's compaction choice, misuse-breaker switch, child-session factory, session-IO retry. Absent bundle = the capability run-narrows `off(reason: … subagentServices …)` like any missing platform service — the complex never half-wires.
- **`_wireFabric` / `_wireTaskSurface`** — the builder assembles the messaging fabric (file layer over `sessionRoot`; hub primary only when the hub transport survived run-narrowing; E1-loud when the hub wires without a `mainMailbox` resolver), then the `SubagentManager` → A2A gateway (a2a transport) → heartbeat (started, kill-switch aware) → `TaskToolConfig` (children draw the child-safe core list; live stream/model accessors) → monitoring tools → `task`, gated by `HostCapability.messagingFabric`/`HostCapability.subagents`.
- **Registry order preserved byte-identically**: `buildAgentStack` now emits core tools → gated task surface (monitoring, then `task` LAST) → residual `additionalTools` — exactly the pre-conversion registration order. The gated surface stays OUT of `WiredAgentCore.tools` (children must never draw it; the executor strips only `task` itself).
- **Catalog corrections** — `subagents` now requires `{sessionRoot, subagentServices}`; `messagingFabric`'s file transport declares `sessionRoot` per-transport (a hub-only host without a session root no longer silently promises the file layer).
- **`WiredAgentCore` exposes the handles** (`fabric`, `fileFabric`, `messagesRoot`, `subagentManager`, `a2aManager`, `subagentHeartbeat`, `taskConfig`) — the CLI (`AgentCli`) keeps `/agents`, wake, mailbox and job-manager behavior unchanged, passing only callbacks (registry persistence closures, `_launchMailboxWake`, `_deliverHeartbeatDigest`, child-session minting over `_repo`). Net: the shell lost ~140 lines of hand-rolled assembly.
- **AGENTS.md** — the host-shell wiring rule now names the builder-owned task complex (conventions invariant).

## Remaining (later slices, per the issue)

- Checkpoint/roles/queue/approval/redaction post-construction attachments into the builder (slice 4).
- Model-facing emission through the plan (prompt sections/help driven by `surfacedTokens`).
- Remaining host shells (macOS/iOS/Android/web/extension/Outlook) consume `wireAgentCore`; config-section parity (#1078) generalizes onto the builder per OQ1.

## Local verification (honest disclosure)

The main checkout's system dart is unusable here (flutter shim dies on seatbelt-blocked engine-stamp writes; the bare VM is SIGKILLed with exit 137 by the machine guard — the known lane pitfall). Gates ran in the worktree via a sibling lane's temp Dart SDK 3.13.4 + the fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`:

- `dart test test/hosts/ test/parity/` — **80/80 green** (matrix completeness, E1/E2, AC7 hiding, parity guards).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart` — **87/87 green** (the CLI constructor end-to-end over the moved wiring).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_agents_panel_test.dart test/task/subagent_lifecycle_test.dart` — **36/36 green** (registry persistence/rehydration through the builder-assembled manager; child resume/wake).
- `dart analyze lib/src/hosts lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart test/hosts` — clean. `dart format` applied (3.13.4; it reflowed two pre-existing spots in the hosts test/catalog that the previous slice's formatter version had left non-canonical).

New tests fail-first: the slice-3 group was written before the implementation (absent-bundle narrowing, child-safety of the core list, canonical order, fabric composition, handle exposure, off-profile hiding) and went green with the builder changes.

- **Additions**: +713
- **Deletions**: -252

- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T09:54:56Z

## PR Description

Part of #1079

## Delivered (slice 3 — builder-owned jobs)

**The task/subagent/fabric complex moves into the capability-gated assembled set (PR #1230's first "Remaining" item); the CLI no longer passes `task`/monitoring as post-plan host tools nor hand-assembles the manager.**

- **`SubagentServices`** (`lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart`, new) — the typed bundle of genuinely shell-side glue: wake launcher, registry sink/source, heartbeat delivery + live thresholds, roles resolver, children's compaction choice, misuse-breaker switch, child-session factory, session-IO retry. Absent bundle = the capability run-narrows `off(reason: … subagentServices …)` like any missing platform service — the complex never half-wires.
- **`_wireFabric` / `_wireTaskSurface`** — the builder assembles the messaging fabric (file layer over `sessionRoot`; hub primary only when the hub transport survived run-narrowing; E1-loud when the hub wires without a `mainMailbox` resolver), then the `SubagentManager` → A2A gateway (a2a transport) → heartbeat (started, kill-switch aware) → `TaskToolConfig` (children draw the child-safe core list; live stream/model accessors) → monitoring tools → `task`, gated by `HostCapability.messagingFabric`/`HostCapability.subagents`.
- **Registry order preserved byte-identically**: `buildAgentStack` now emits core tools → gated task surface (monitoring, then `task` LAST) → residual `additionalTools` — exactly the pre-conversion registration order. The gated surface stays OUT of `WiredAgentCore.tools` (children must never draw it; the executor strips only `task` itself).
- **Catalog corrections** — `subagents` now requires `{sessionRoot, subagentServices}`; `messagingFabric`'s file transport declares `sessionRoot` per-transport (a hub-only host without a session root no longer silently promises the file layer).
- **`WiredAgentCore` exposes the handles** (`fabric`, `fileFabric`, `messagesRoot`, `subagentManager`, `a2aManager`, `subagentHeartbeat`, `taskConfig`) — the CLI (`AgentCli`) keeps `/agents`, wake, mailbox and job-manager behavior unchanged, passing only callbacks (registry persistence closures, `_launchMailboxWake`, `_deliverHeartbeatDigest`, child-session minting over `_repo`). Net: the shell lost ~140 lines of hand-rolled assembly.
- **AGENTS.md** — the host-shell wiring rule now names the builder-owned task complex (conventions invariant).

## Remaining (later slices, per the issue)

- Checkpoint/roles/queue/approval/redaction post-construction attachments into the builder (slice 4).
- Model-facing emission through the plan (prompt sections/help driven by `surfacedTokens`).
- Remaining host shells (macOS/iOS/Android/web/extension/Outlook) consume `wireAgentCore`; config-section parity (#1078) generalizes onto the builder per OQ1.

## Local verification (honest disclosure)

The main checkout's system dart is unusable here (flutter shim dies on seatbelt-blocked engine-stamp writes; the bare VM is SIGKILLed with exit 137 by the machine guard — the known lane pitfall). Gates ran in the worktree via a sibling lane's temp Dart SDK 3.13.4 + the fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`:

- `dart test test/hosts/ test/parity/` — **80/80 green** (matrix completeness, E1/E2, AC7 hiding, parity guards).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart` — **87/87 green** (the CLI constructor end-to-end over the moved wiring).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_agents_panel_test.dart test/task/subagent_lifecycle_test.dart` — **36/36 green** (registry persistence/rehydration through the builder-assembled manager; child resume/wake).
- `dart analyze lib/src/hosts lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart test/hosts` — clean. `dart format` applied (3.13.4; it reflowed two pre-existing spots in the hosts test/catalog that the previous slice's formatter version had left non-canonical).

New tests fail-first: the slice-3 group was written before the implementation (absent-bundle narrowing, child-safety of the core list, canonical order, fabric composition, handle exposure, off-profile hiding) and went green with the builder changes.

Very important finding! The **mobile profile declares `messagingFabric: CapabilityTransportState({'hub'}, 'no shared filesystem; hub-only messaging')`**. That's a latent design gap: `_wireFabric` cannot assemble a hub-only fabric. The catalog correction in this PR explicitly says "a hub-only host without a session root no longer silently promises the file layer" — but `_wireFabric` doesn't just skip the file layer, it skips the ENTIRE fabric including the wired hub transport. Silent narrowing below the plan (no reason recorded) — exactly the "silent" behavior E1 exists to prevent. For the CLI (file+hub+a2a all default, sessionRoot always present), it doesn't bite today. It's worth an IMPORTANT finding: `_wireFabric` silently drops the whole capability when file transport is absent even if hub wires — should either throw E1-loud or narrow with a reason.

## PR Description

Part of #1079

## Delivered (slice 3 — builder-owned jobs)

**The task/subagent/fabric complex moves into the capability-gated assembled set (PR #1230's first "Remaining" item); the CLI no longer passes `task`/monitoring as post-plan host tools nor hand-assembles the manager.**

- **`SubagentServices`** (`lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart`, new) — the typed bundle of genuinely shell-side glue: wake launcher, registry sink/source, heartbeat delivery + live thresholds, roles resolver, children's compaction choice, misuse-breaker switch, child-session factory, session-IO retry. Absent bundle = the capability run-narrows `off(reason: … subagentServices …)` like any missing platform service — the complex never half-wires.
- **`_wireFabric` / `_wireTaskSurface`** — the builder assembles the messaging fabric (file layer over `sessionRoot`; hub primary only when the hub transport survived run-narrowing; E1-loud when the hub wires without a `mainMailbox` resolver), then the `SubagentManager` → A2A gateway (a2a transport) → heartbeat (started, kill-switch aware) → `TaskToolConfig` (children draw the child-safe core list; live stream/model accessors) → monitoring tools → `task`, gated by `HostCapability.messagingFabric`/`HostCapability.subagents`.
- **Registry order preserved byte-identically**: `buildAgentStack` now emits core tools → gated task surface (monitoring, then `task` LAST) → residual `additionalTools` — exactly the pre-conversion registration order. The gated surface stays OUT of `WiredAgentCore.tools` (children must never draw it; the executor strips only `task` itself).
- **Catalog corrections** — `subagents` now requires `{sessionRoot, subagentServices}`; `messagingFabric`'s file transport declares `sessionRoot` per-transport (a hub-only host without a session root no longer silently promises the file layer).
- **`WiredAgentCore` exposes the handles** (`fabric`, `fileFabric`, `messagesRoot`, `subagentManager`, `a2aManager`, `subagentHeartbeat`, `taskConfig`) — the CLI (`AgentCli`) keeps `/agents`, wake, mailbox and job-manager behavior unchanged, passing only callbacks (registry persistence closures, `_launchMailboxWake`, `_deliverHeartbeatDigest`, child-session minting over `_repo`). Net: the shell lost ~140 lines of hand-rolled assembly.
- **AGENTS.md** — the host-shell wiring rule now names the builder-owned task complex (conventions invariant).

## Remaining (later slices, per the issue)

- Checkpoint/roles/queue/approval/redaction post-construction attachments into the builder (slice 4).
- Model-facing emission through the plan (prompt sections/help driven by `surfacedTokens`).
- Remaining host shells (macOS/iOS/Android/web/extension/Outlook) consume `wireAgentCore`; config-section parity (#1078) generalizes onto the builder per OQ1.

## Local verification (honest disclosure)

The main checkout's system dart is unusable here (flutter shim dies on seatbelt-blocked engine-stamp writes; the bare VM is SIGKILLed with exit 137 by the machine guard — the known lane pitfall). Gates ran in the worktree via a sibling lane's temp Dart SDK 3.13.4 + the fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`:

- `dart test test/hosts/ test/parity/` — **80/80 green** (matrix completeness, E1/E2, AC7 hiding, parity guards).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart` — **87/87 green** (the CLI constructor end-to-end over the moved wiring).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_agents_panel_test.dart test/task/subagent_lifecycle_test.dart` — **36/36 green** (registry persistence/rehydration through the builder-assembled manager; child resume/wake).
- `dart analyze lib/src/hosts lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart test/hosts` — clean. `dart format` applied (3.13.4; it reflowed two pre-existing spots in the hosts test/catalog that the previous slice's formatter version had left non-canonical).

New tests fail-first: the slice-3 group was written before the implementation (absent-bundle narrowing, child-safety of the core list, canonical order, fabric composition, handle exposure, off-profile hiding) and went green with the builder changes.

surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. Outputs Write the standard review artifacts: - `outputs/pr_review.json` — structured data with `recommendation`, `summary`, `inlineComments`, `issueCounts` - `outputs/pr_review_general.md` — 1-2 paragraph general PR comment - `outputs/pr_review_comments/*.md` — one file per detailed inline comment **Inline comment lines must be present in the PR diff.** GitHub review threads can only be attached to added or context lines inside a diff hunk. If `pr_diff.txt` is truncated, run `git diff origin/{baseBranch}...HEAD` to locate the correct line numbers. Findings on unchanged code outside the diff belong in `outputs/pr_review_general.md`, not as inline comments. Do NOT write `outputs/response.md`; the review is posted to GitHub only. ```mermaid flowchart TD O1["Write outputs/pr_review.json — structured data for GitHub PR review…

## PR Description

Part of #1079

## Delivered (slice 3 — builder-owned jobs)

**The task/subagent/fabric complex moves into the capability-gated assembled set (PR #1230's first "Remaining" item); the CLI no longer passes `task`/monitoring as post-plan host tools nor hand-assembles the manager.**

- **`SubagentServices`** (`lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart`, new) — the typed bundle of genuinely shell-side glue: wake launcher, registry sink/source, heartbeat delivery + live thresholds, roles resolver, children's compaction choice, misuse-breaker switch, child-session factory, session-IO retry. Absent bundle = the capability run-narrows `off(reason: … subagentServices …)` like any missing platform service — the complex never half-wires.
- **`_wireFabric` / `_wireTaskSurface`** — the builder assembles the messaging fabric (file layer over `sessionRoot`; hub primary only when the hub transport survived run-narrowing; E1-loud when the hub wires without a `mainMailbox` resolver), then the `SubagentManager` → A2A gateway (a2a transport) → heartbeat (started, kill-switch aware) → `TaskToolConfig` (children draw the child-safe core list; live stream/model accessors) → monitoring tools → `task`, gated by `HostCapability.messagingFabric`/`HostCapability.subagents`.
- **Registry order preserved byte-identically**: `buildAgentStack` now emits core tools → gated task surface (monitoring, then `task` LAST) → residual `additionalTools` — exactly the pre-conversion registration order. The gated surface stays OUT of `WiredAgentCore.tools` (children must never draw it; the executor strips only `task` itself).
- **Catalog corrections** — `subagents` now requires `{sessionRoot, subagentServices}`; `messagingFabric`'s file transport declares `sessionRoot` per-transport (a hub-only host without a session root no longer silently promises the file layer).
- **`WiredAgentCore` exposes the handles** (`fabric`, `fileFabric`, `messagesRoot`, `subagentManager`, `a2aManager`, `subagentHeartbeat`, `taskConfig`) — the CLI (`AgentCli`) keeps `/agents`, wake, mailbox and job-manager behavior unchanged, passing only callbacks (registry persistence closures, `_launchMailboxWake`, `_deliverHeartbeatDigest`, child-session minting over `_repo`). Net: the shell lost ~140 lines of hand-rolled assembly.
- **AGENTS.md** — the host-shell wiring rule now names the builder-owned task complex (conventions invariant).

## Remaining (later slices, per the issue)

- Checkpoint/roles/queue/approval/redaction post-construction attachments into the builder (slice 4).
- Model-facing emission through the plan (prompt sections/help driven by `surfacedTokens`).
- Remaining host shells (macOS/iOS/Android/web/extension/Outlook) consume `wireAgentCore`; config-section parity (#1078) generalizes onto the builder per OQ1.

## Local verification (honest disclosure)

The main checkout's system dart is unusable here (flutter shim dies on seatbelt-blocked engine-stamp writes; the bare VM is SIGKILLed with exit 137 by the machine guard — the known lane pitfall). Gates ran in the worktree via a sibling lane's temp Dart SDK 3.13.4 + the fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`:

- `dart test test/hosts/ test/parity/` — **80/80 green** (matrix completeness, E1/E2, AC7 hiding, parity guards).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart` — **87/87 green** (the CLI constructor end-to-end over the moved wiring).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_agents_panel_test.dart test/task/subagent_lifecycle_test.dart` — **36/36 green** (registry persistence/rehydration through the builder-assembled manager; child resume/wake).
- `dart analyze lib/src/hosts lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart test/hosts` — clean. `dart format` applied (3.13.4; it reflowed two pre-existing spots in the hosts test/catalog that the previous slice's formatter version had left non-canonical).

New tests fail-first: the slice-3 group was written before the implementation (absent-bundle narrowing, child-safety of the core list, canonical order, fabric composition, handle exposure, off-profile hiding) and went green with the builder changes.

- **PR #**: 1313

- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1079-sdk-host-slice3` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 6
- **Additions**: +713
- **Deletions**: -252
- **Created**: 2026-10-06T09:54:56Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T09:54:56Z

## PR Description

Part of #1079

## Delivered (slice 3 — builder-owned jobs)

**The task/subagent/fabric complex moves into the capability-gated assembled set (PR #1230's first "Remaining" item); the CLI no longer passes `task`/monitoring as post-plan host tools nor hand-assembles the manager.**

- **`SubagentServices`** (`lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart`, new) — the typed bundle of genuinely shell-side glue: wake launcher, registry sink/source, heartbeat delivery + live thresholds, roles resolver, children's compaction choice, misuse-breaker switch, child-session factory, session-IO retry. Absent bundle = the capability run-narrows `off(reason: … subagentServices …)` like any missing platform service — the complex never half-wires.
- **`_wireFabric` / `_wireTaskSurface`** — the builder assembles the messaging fabric (file layer over `sessionRoot`; hub primary only when the hub transport survived run-narrowing; E1-loud when the hub wires without a `mainMailbox` resolver), then the `SubagentManager` → A2A gateway (a2a transport) → heartbeat (started, kill-switch aware) → `TaskToolConfig` (children draw the child-safe core list; live stream/model accessors) → monitoring tools → `task`, gated by `HostCapability.messagingFabric`/`HostCapability.subagents`.
- **Registry order preserved byte-identically**: `buildAgentStack` now emits core tools → gated task surface (monitoring, then `task` LAST) → residual `additionalTools` — exactly the pre-conversion registration order. The gated surface stays OUT of `WiredAgentCore.tools` (children must never draw it; the executor strips only `task` itself).
- **Catalog corrections** — `subagents` now requires `{sessionRoot, subagentServices}`; `messagingFabric`'s file transport declares `sessionRoot` per-transport (a hub-only host without a session root no longer silently promises the file layer).
- **`WiredAgentCore` exposes the handles** (`fabric`, `fileFabric`, `messagesRoot`, `subagentManager`, `a2aManager`, `subagentHeartbeat`, `taskConfig`) — the CLI (`AgentCli`) keeps `/agents`, wake, mailbox and job-manager behavior unchanged, passing only callbacks (registry persistence closures, `_launchMailboxWake`, `_deliverHeartbeatDigest`, child-session minting over `_repo`). Net: the shell lost ~140 lines of hand-rolled assembly.
- **AGENTS.md** — the host-shell wiring rule now names the builder-owned task complex (conventions invariant).

## Remaining (later slices, per the issue)

- Checkpoint/roles/queue/approval/redaction post-construction attachments into the builder (slice 4).
- Model-facing emission through the plan (prompt sections/help driven by `surfacedTokens`).
- Remaining host shells (macOS/iOS/Android/web/extension/Outlook) consume `wireAgentCore`; config-section parity (#1078) generalizes onto the builder per OQ1.

## Local verification (honest disclosure)

The main checkout's system dart is unusable here (flutter shim dies on seatbelt-blocked engine-stamp writes; the bare VM is SIGKILLed with exit 137 by the machine guard — the known lane pitfall). Gates ran in the worktree via a sibling lane's temp Dart SDK 3.13.4 + the fleet `$TMPDIR/fah-pub-cache`:

- `dart test test/hosts/ test/parity/` — **80/80 green** (matrix completeness, E1/E2, AC7 hiding, parity guards).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_cli_test.dart` — **87/87 green** (the CLI constructor end-to-end over the moved wiring).
- `dart test test/cli/agent_agents_panel_test.dart test/task/subagent_lifecycle_test.dart` — **36/36 green** (registry persistence/rehydration through the builder-assembled manager; child resume/wake).
- `dart analyze lib/src/hosts lib/src/cli/agent_cli.dart test/hosts` — clean. `dart format` applied (3.13.4; it reflowed two pre-existing spots in the hosts test/catalog that the previous slice's formatter version had left non-canonical).

New tests fail-first: the slice-3 group was written before the implementation (absent-bundle narrowing, child-safety of the core list, canonical order, fabric composition, handle exposure, off-profile hiding) and went green with the builder changes.

All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Review Guidelines — evaluate against existing codebase patterns"] G2["Before reviewing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists → READ it — defines coding styles to check against"] G4["Flag deviations from established patterns unless justified in PR description"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 ``` # PR Review General Guidelines ## Review flow ```mermaid flowchart TD START([PR ready for review]) --> READ["1. Read input context:
instruction.md, ticket.md, pr_info.md,

callers/callees of changed symbols,

impact analysis"] CODEGRAPH --> DIMS["5. Evaluate review dimensions:
Security · Architecture/OOP · Code quality
Test coverage · Duplication · Backward compatibility"] DIMS --> SEVERITY["6. Classify each finding:
BLOCKING / IMPORTANT / SUGGESTION"] SEVERITY --> EXHAUST["7. Exhaustive pass:
re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Impact analysis (CodeGraph or grep fallback) Use CodeGraph to find "what could break": - `codegraph_callers` / `codegraph_callees` on modified public symbols - `codegraph_search` for: `PAT_TOKEN`, `secrets.`, `github.token`, `previousViewModel` - `codegraph_impact` before flagging architectural changes **If CodeGraph unavailable**, use grep and document it: ```bash grep -rn "changedFunctionName" --include="*.ts" . grep -rn "secrets\.\|github\.token" . ``` ## 5. Review dimensions Rate the PR across all relevant dimensions: | Dimension | What to check | |---|---| | **Security** | injection, unsafe interpolation, secret leakage, missing permissions, unsafe defaults | | **Architecture / OOP** | SRP, coupling, abstraction consistency, provider/repository boundaries | | **Code quality** | naming, complexity, error handling, logging, comments | | **Tests** | coverage for new/changed paths, meaningful assertions, no brittle string-only tests | | **Duplication** | copy-paste, duplicated logic across files, duplicated configuration | | **Backward compatibility** | public API changes, migration paths, default behavior | | **Performance** | unnecessary rebuilds, heavy sync operations, missing timeouts | | **Workflow / CI safety** | (when `.github/workflows/` changes) secret declarations, ref pinning, permissions, timeouts | ## 6. Severity classification Classify every finding before writing outputs: - **BLOCKING** — merge would cause a bug, security issue, data loss, or CI break. Must be fixed. - **IMPORTANT** — real maintainability or correctness issue. Strongly prefer fixing before merge. - **SUGGESTION** — optional improvement, style, or future polish. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. Outputs Write the standard review artifacts: - `outputs/pr_review.json` — structured data with `recommendation`, `summary`, `inlineComments`, `issueCounts` - `outputs/pr_review_general.md` — 1-2 paragraph general PR comment - `outputs/pr_review_comments/*.md` — one file per detailed inline comment **Inline comment lines must be present in the PR diff.** GitHub review threads can only be attached to added or context lines inside a diff hunk. If `pr_diff.txt` is truncated, run `git diff origin/{baseBranch}...HEAD` to locate the correct line numbers. Findings on unchanged code outside the diff belong in `outputs/pr_review_general.md`, not as inline comments. Do NOT write `outputs/response.md`; the review is posted to GitHub only. ```mermaid flowchart TD O1["Write outputs/pr_review.json — structured data for GitHub PR review…

- **Updated**: 2026-10-06T09:54:56Z

## PR Description

Part of #1079

## Delivered (slice 3 — builder-owned jobs)

**The task/subagent/fabric complex moves into the capability-gated assembled set (PR #1230's first "Remaining" item); the CLI no longer passes `task`/monitoring as post-plan host tools nor hand-assembles the manager.**

- **`SubagentServices`** (`lib/src/hosts/host_agent_wiring.dart`, new) — the typed bundle of genuinely shell-side glue: wake launcher, registry sink/source, heartbeat delivery + live thresholds, roles resolver, children's compaction choice, misuse-breaker switch, child-session factory, session-IO retry. Absent bundle = the capability run-narrows `off(reason: … subagentServices …)` like any missing platform service — the complex never half-wires.
- **`_wireFabric` / `_wireTaskSurface`** — the builder assembles the messaging fabric (file layer over `sessionRoot`; hub primary only when the hub transport survived run-narrowing; E1-loud when the hub wires without a `mainMailbox` resolver), then the `SubagentManager` → A2A gateway (a2a transport) → heartbeat (started, kill-switch aware) → `TaskToolConfig` (children draw the child-safe core list; live stream/model accessors) → monitoring tools → `task`, gated by `HostCapability.messagingFabric`/`HostCapability.subagents`.
- **Registry order preserved byte-identically**: `buildAgentStack` now emits core tools → gated task surface (monitoring, then `task` LAST) → residual `additionalTools` — exactly the pre-conversion registration order. The gated surface stays OUT of `WiredAgentCore.tools` (children must never draw it; the executor strips only `task` itself).
- **Catalog corrections** — `subagents` now requires `{sessionRoot, subagentServices}`; `messagingFabric`'s file transport declares `sessionRoot` per-transport (a hub-only host without a session root no longer silently promises the file layer).
- **`WiredAgentCore` exposes the handles** (`fabric`, `fileFabric`, `messagesRoot`, `subagentManager`, `a2aManager`, `subagentHeartbeat`, `taskConfig`) — the CLI (`AgentCli`) keeps `/agents`, wake, mailbox and job-manager behavior unchanged, passing only callbacks (registry persistence closures, `_launchMailboxWake`, `_deliverHeartbeatDigest`, child-session minting over `_repo`). Net: the shell lost ~140 lines of hand-rolled assembly.
- **AGENTS.md** — the host-shell wiring rule now names the builder-owned task complex (conventions invariant).

## Remaining (later slices, per the issue)

- Checkpoint/roles/queue/approval/redaction post-construction attachments into the builder (slice 4).
- Model-facing emission through the plan (prompt sections/help driven by `surfacedTokens`).
